content: Compliance with Profile of Data Exchange Point A Profile of Data Exchange Point can tailor the AUTOSAR Data Format for a specific Data Exchange Point. This tailoring of Data Format Element s (Meta- Classes, Attributes, Constraints, Sdg usage) specifies a subset of the meta model that is relevant for this specific Data Exchange Point and defines which AUTOSAR and custom validation rules have to be evaluated. An AUTOSAR Model complies with a Profile of Data Exchange Point if all validation rules evaluate to true.
